items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: And the MC said, Oh, boy, what a storm out there.

ctx.x: And you worked there, huh, Batone?

I'll tell you, you get playing, you can hear the tin, you know, the rain. Oh, man, like it was a storm. That thing would come down. And the MC said, Oh, boy, what a storm out there. Boy, it's raining like hell. He says, No way you folks can go now. He says, No, you have to stay here, see. He says, We'll just have to stay here all morning so it'll stop raining. Some people say, Oh, rain or no rain, I got to go home, see. They go outside, no rain, dry, you know. Well, that was funny. And a lot of people don't know…
Yeah, but I wouldn't remember that.
